description: Implementation of GLAccountReadPlatformService for accessing GL account data from the database, including methods for retrieving accounts by various criteria, mapping database rows to data objects, and handling account types and usage filters.

classes.name: GLAccountReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing GLAccountReadPlatformService for reading GL account data from the database.

classes.name: GLAccountMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping SQL result set to GLAccountData objects, with optional inclusion of running balance data.

classes.name: GLAccountDataLookUpMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping SQL result set to GLAccountDataForLookup objects for account lookup purposes.

methods.name: retrieveAllGLAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves all GL accounts matching specified filters such as classification, search param, usage, manual transactions allowed, and disabled status.

methods.name: retrieveGLAccountById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific GL account by its ID, with optional inclusion of running balance data.

methods.name: retrieveAllEnabledDetailGLAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves all enabled GL accounts with 'DETAIL' usage for a given account type.

methods.name: retrieveAllEnabledDetailGLAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves all enabled GL accounts with 'DETAIL' usage regardless of account type.

methods.name: retrieveNewGLAccountDetails
methods.description: Provides default details for creating a new GL account of a specified type.

methods.name: retrieveAllEnabledHeaderGLAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves all enabled GL accounts with 'HEADER' usage for a given account type.

methods.name: retrieveAccountsByTagId
methods.description: Retrieves GL accounts associated with a specific rule ID and transaction type for lookup purposes.
